Package org.bsc.langgraph4j

Interface GraphDefinition<State extends AgentState>

Type Parameters:
State - the type of state managed by the graph, extending AgentState
All Known Implementing Classes:
CompiledGraph, MessagesStateGraph, StateGraph
public sealed interface GraphDefinition<State extends AgentState> permits StateGraph<State>, CompiledGraph<State>
Defines the contract for graph structures that manage state and control flow.

  • Method Details

    • reduce

      <Output> Output reduce(GraphDefinition.Reducer<State,Output> reducer)
      Applies a reducer function to process the nodes and edges of this graph.

      This method allows external processing of the graph structure by applying a custom reduction function that receives all nodes and edges.

      Type Parameters:
      Output - the type of output produced by the reducer
      Parameters:
      reducer - the reducer function to apply
      Returns:
      the output produced by the reducer
